title: Start a simple HTTP server for the current folder
summary: Quickly serve files from your current directory over HTTP on port 8000. Useful for testing web pages or sharing files locally.

steps.explain: Start a built-in HTTP server in the current directory on port 8000.
steps.expect: The terminal will show 'Serving HTTP on 0.0.0.0 port 8000 (http://0.0.0.0:8000/) ...' and stay running.
